messages.window.title: Project Zomboid Memory Configurator
messages.app.title: Project Zomboid RAM Configurator
messages.app.subtitle: Set the game client's Java heap limit (-Xmx) so heavy mod packs are less likely to crash from running out of memory.
messages.location.title: Game location
messages.location.loading: Detecting system memory and the Project Zomboid install folder…
messages.location.notfound: Project Zomboid install folder not found. Use “Choose folder…” to pick the game root. That folder must contain ProjectZomboid64.json or its .bak backup.
messages.location.invalidRecovery: Restore from backup to return to the previous config, or use Steam's “Verify integrity of game files” and then click “Reload config”.
messages.location.fixedDir: This session uses the folder given on the command line and never searches for other installations.
messages.location.notGameRoot: This folder has no readable ProjectZomboid64.json and no .bak backup beside it. Check that the path shown above is the game root, or pick it again with “Choose folder…”; the details below are the reason reported by the system.
messages.install.title: Multiple installations found, pick the one to configure
messages.install.note: These are the Project Zomboid install folders that were found automatically. If none of them is the right one, cancel and use “Choose folder…” instead.
messages.install.label: Install folder
messages.memory.title: Memory overview
messages.memory.writeDisabled: System RAM could not be detected, so nothing will be written; only restoring from a backup is possible.
messages.chart.noRecommendation: System RAM is below 8 GB, so there is no recommendation
messages.strategy.title: Limit to apply
messages.strategy.note: Both presets are starting strategies, not official recommendations or benchmark results. Choosing a preset only updates the preview; the current limit does not change until you confirm Apply.
messages.strategy.heavySummary: For modded servers and higher memory needs.
messages.strategy.heavyDescription: Heavy mods: for modded servers and higher memory needs. Uses the smaller of 80% of installed RAM or RAM minus 4 GB, rounded down.
messages.strategy.balancedSummary: More room for other apps; may be too low for heavy mods.
messages.strategy.balancedDescription: Leave room for other apps: uses the smaller of 50% of installed RAM or RAM minus 4 GB, rounded down. Leaves more room for a browser, Discord, and similar apps, but may be too low for some heavy mod packs. This strategy has not been tested in-game.
messages.strategy.customSummary: Use your server's client-side suggestion or choose your own.
messages.strategy.customDescription: Custom: use your server's client-side recommendation, or keep a setting you already know. Do not copy the dedicated server's own memory allocation.
messages.strategy.customHint: Enter a positive integer in GB, less than system RAM. It may be higher than the recommendation; this tool will not cap you at the recommended value.
messages.strategy.unavailable: Physical RAM is under 8 GB, so no automatic recommendation
messages.validation.integer: Enter a positive integer in GB, with no decimals, letters, or units.
messages.validation.belowTotal: Enter an integer below system RAM ({total}). The config was not changed.
messages.warning.title: Please note:
messages.warning.heavyNeeds: Background-app mode may be too low for some heavy mod packs. If the server gives a player-side recommendation, check that first.
messages.warning.above: {value} is above the recommended {limit} and may leave less memory for other programs.
messages.warning.lower: {value} is below the current {current}, so the game will have less memory.
messages.warning.free: {value} is close to or above the currently available {free}, so the game may run slowly or fail to start.
messages.diff.label: Before / after
messages.diff.noGame: Choose a game folder first to see the value that would be written.
messages.diff.unreadable: The config cannot be read, so nothing will be written.
messages.diff.noValue: Currently {current}. Choose a recommendation or enter a custom value.
messages.diff.same: Same as the current setting. Apply will not change the file or update the backup.
messages.backup.none: No backup yet. The first Apply saves the full config as a .bak before changing it.
messages.backup.unusable: {name} was found but cannot be used as a backup: {reason}
messages.backup.unusableFix: Move this .bak somewhere safe or repair it first (fix the JSON, clear the read-only flag), then click “Reload config”. Do not restore the config from a backup that cannot be read.
messages.apply.title: Set the memory limit?
messages.apply.same: The current setting is already {value}. Apply will not change the file or update the backup.
messages.apply.change: Currently {current}, will be set to {next}. The change takes effect the next time you launch the game.
messages.restore.title: Restore from backup?
messages.restore.detail: Backup {name} ({age}) has a memory limit of {limit}. Confirming replaces the target config below with this backup in full.
messages.restore.note: Restore overwrites the entire config and may undo a game update or other manual edits. The backup file is kept.
messages.status.detecting: Detecting system RAM and the game install location…
messages.status.cancelled: Cancelled. The config was not changed.
messages.status.notfound: Project Zomboid install folder still not found.
messages.status.notfoundHint: Use “Choose folder…” to pick the game root.
messages.status.same: The current setting is already {value}. The file was not changed and the backup was not updated.
messages.status.nextLaunch: The change takes effect the next time you launch the game.
messages.status.restoreOverwrote: This restores the entire config and may undo a Steam update or other manual edits.
messages.status.workingNoClose: Working on the files, please wait. The window stays open until this operation finishes so a backup, replacement, or read is never interrupted half way.
messages.worker.gone: The background worker has stopped, so this operation was never submitted.
messages.worker.goneFix: Nothing was changed by this operation. Close the tool, start it again, and reload the config to check the current state.
messages.err.io.title: File access failed.
messages.err.io.fix: This can happen before the write, but also during the read-back after a successful replacement, so the config may already have changed. Click “Reload config” first to check the current limit and the backup, then decide what to do; also make sure the game is fully closed and the path still exists and is writable.
messages.err.invalid_json.title: The config file is not valid JSON, so it cannot be changed safely.
messages.err.invalid_json.fix: Restore from backup to return to the previous config, or use Steam's “Verify integrity of game files” and then click “Reload config”.
messages.err.invalid_heap.title: The -Xmx value in the config is missing, duplicated, or not safe to parse, so it will not be changed.
messages.err.invalid_heap.fix: Restore from backup to return to the previous config, or use Steam's “Verify integrity of game files” and then click “Reload config”.
messages.err.invalid_value.title: The memory limit you entered is invalid; the config was not changed.
messages.err.invalid_value.fix: Enter a positive integer in GB, less than system RAM.
messages.err.memory_unavailable.title: System RAM could not be detected, so no recommendation is offered and nothing will be written.
messages.err.memory_unavailable.fix: Only restoring from a backup is possible. Restart the tool and try again; if it keeps failing, check that system information services are healthy.
messages.err.read_only.title: The config file is read-only; nothing was written.
messages.err.read_only.fix: Clear the read-only flag on the file, or run this tool as administrator.
messages.err.changed.title: The target config or the backup was modified by another program in the meantime, so nothing was written.
messages.err.changed.fix: Click “Reload config” to load the latest content, then apply again.
messages.err.xms_conflict.title: The existing -Xms (initial heap) in the config is larger than the requested limit, so nothing was written.
messages.err.xms_conflict.fix: Lower -Xms yourself first; this tool never rewrites -Xms.
messages.err.missing_backup.title: No usable backup file was found.
messages.err.missing_backup.fix: The first Apply saves the full config as a .bak before changing it.
messages.err.replace_failed.title: Replacing the config file failed.
messages.err.replace_failed.fix: The replacement may have been carried out only in part, so the target and the backup may have changed or moved; the original file is not guaranteed to be untouched. Use the paths in the details to preserve the candidate file and the kept backup copy, check what the target and the backup actually contain, then click “Reload config”. Do not delete those files or retry immediately.
messages.err.unknown.title: The operation failed.
messages.err.unknown.fix: Fully close the game and any Steam download or verify job, then try again. If the file is read-only or you lack permission, clear the read-only flag or run as administrator.
